items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 119:1
items.html: (To the question) What is smallness? The two Partzufim of the pregnancy and suckling of every Partzuf are called by the name smallness, because it lacks the Partzuf of the Mochin, which is the aspect of the head of every Partzuf. (Item 60).
